title: Handwritten Notes Image
description: Turn typed text into a realistic photo of handwritten notes on paper.
howToUse: Paste the text you want handwritten, then pick paper stock, pen and lighting so the render looks photographed rather than generated.
example:
/HandwrittenNotesImage
Text: "Meeting takeaways: ship beta Friday, freeze scope"
Paper: lined A5, slightly creased
Pen: blue ballpoint, medium pressure
Lighting: soft desk lamp from the left

title: Exploded View
description: Render any object as a clean exploded-view diagram with labelled parts.
howToUse: Name or attach the object, say how deep the teardown should go, and choose whether labels sit inline or in a legend.
example:
/Explode
Object: mechanical keyboard
Depth: switch, keycap, plate, PCB
Labels: numbered with legend
Style: technical isometric, light background

title: Document Scan
description: Convert a photo of a page into a flat, deskewed, high-contrast scan.
howToUse: Attach the phone photo; state whether you need a searchable PDF, plain text, or both, and whether shadows should be flattened to pure white.
example:
/Scan
Input: IMG_2841.jpg — tilted photo of a receipt
Fix: perspective, shadow, contrast
Output: deskewed PDF + extracted line items

title: 100x Upscale
description: Aggressively upscale a tiny or degraded image while inventing plausible detail.
howToUse: Attach the low-res source and say what must stay faithful (identity, logo shape, text) versus what may be reimagined.
example:
/100xUpscale
Image: old_avatar.jpg — 64×64, heavy JPEG artifacts
Keep faithful: facial identity, hair line
Output: 4096px PNG + artifact report

title: Summarize Anything
description: Compress any text into a faithful summary at the length and reading level you choose.
howToUse: Paste the source, then set target length, audience and whether quotes or numbers must be preserved verbatim.
example:
/Summarize
Length: 5 bullets, max 18 words each
Audience: busy executive
Keep verbatim: revenue figures
Text: <paste>

title: Explain Clearly
description: Explain any concept at the depth and reading level you ask for.
howToUse: Name the concept and your current level; add one thing you already understand so the explanation can build on it.
example:
/Explain
Concept: vector databases
Level: junior developer who knows SQL
Format: one analogy, one worked example, one gotcha

title: Improve My Prompt
description: Rewrite a rough prompt into a precise, well-constrained instruction.
howToUse: Paste your current prompt plus a sample of the disappointing output, so the rewrite targets the actual failure.
example:
/PromptImprove
Prompt: "write me a blog post"
Bad output: generic listicle, no specifics
Goal: 900 words, practitioner voice, one original framework

title: Clean CSV
description: Normalize headers, fix types, trim whitespace and remove duplicate rows.
howToUse: Attach the CSV, name the column that uniquely identifies a row, and list any formats that must be enforced.
example:
/CleanCsv
File: contacts.csv — 12,400 rows
Unique key: email
Rules: lowercase emails, ISO-8601 dates, strip trailing spaces
Report: rows dropped and why

title: Code Review
description: Get a senior-level review covering bugs, edge cases and readability.
howToUse: Paste the diff or file, name the language and runtime, and say which failure would hurt most in production.
example:
/CodeReview
Language: TypeScript (Node 22)
Worst case: duplicate charges on retry
Code: <paste diff>

title: Meeting Recap
description: Turn a messy transcript into decisions, owners, dates and open questions.
howToUse: Paste the transcript or raw notes and list the attendees so owners can be attributed correctly.
example:
/MeetingRecap
Attendees: Sara (PM), Dan (eng), Mei (design)
Transcript: <paste>
Output: decisions, actions with owner + due date, unresolved questions

title: Deblur Image
description: Recover sharp edges and readable text from a motion-blurred photo.
howToUse: Attach the blurry frame and point at the region that has to become legible — sharpening is prioritised there.
example:
/Deblur
Image: whiteboard.jpg — handheld, 1/15s shutter
Priority region: top-left column of text
Avoid: halo artifacts

title: Translate Document
description: Translate a full document while preserving layout, headings and terminology.
howToUse: Attach the document, set source and target language, and paste any glossary or do-not-translate list.
example:
/TranslateDoc
From: English
To: German (formal Sie)
Do not translate: product names, SKU codes
Keep: heading hierarchy and table layout

title: Daily Plan
description: Turn a task dump into a realistic, energy-aware plan for the day.
howToUse: List your tasks, fixed commitments and honest available hours; flag which task you dread so it can be placed well.
example:
/DailyPlan
Hours available: 6
Fixed: standup 10:00, client call 15:30
Dreaded task: expense report
Tasks: <list>

title: Build Regex
description: Generate and explain a regular expression from examples of matches and non-matches.
howToUse: Give at least three strings that must match and three that must not, plus the regex flavour you target.
example:
/RegexBuild
Match: A-1234, B-9999, Z-0001
No match: AB-123, 1234, a-1234
Flavor: JavaScript
Want: named capture group for the letter

title: SQL From Text
description: Turn a plain-English question into a correct, readable SQL query.
howToUse: Paste the relevant table definitions and ask the question the way you would ask a colleague.
example:
/SqlFromText
Schema: orders(id, user_id, total_cents, created_at), users(id, country)
Question: monthly revenue per country for 2025, excluding refunds
Dialect: Postgres

title: Alt Text
description: Write concise, screen-reader friendly alt text for any image.
howToUse: Attach the image and describe the surrounding content, since good alt text depends on what the page already says.
example:
/AltText
Image: revenue_chart.png
Page context: blog post already states Q4 revenue in the paragraph above
Limit: 125 characters

title: Anonymize Text
description: Replace names, emails, phone numbers and IDs with consistent placeholders.
howToUse: Paste the text and choose the placeholder style; the same person keeps the same token throughout.
example:
/Anonymize
Style: [PERSON_1], [EMAIL_1], [ORG_1]
Also mask: order numbers
Text: <paste support thread>

title: Storyboard Video
description: Break a video idea into numbered shots with framing, action and voiceover.
howToUse: Describe the idea, the runtime and the platform; say whether you shoot on phone or with a crew.
example:
/Storyboard
Idea: 45s product teaser
Platform: Instagram Reels, 9:16
Shot on: iPhone, single operator
Tone: calm, no hard sell

title: Compare Options
description: Build a weighted comparison table and give a clear recommendation.
howToUse: List the options and the criteria that matter, with rough weights if some criteria dominate.
example:
/CompareOptions
Options: Notion, Obsidian, Craft
Criteria: offline (40%), collaboration (35%), price (25%)
Output: scored table + one-line verdict

title: Rubber Duck
description: Interrogate your reasoning with pointed questions until the bug surfaces.
howToUse: Describe the bug, what you already tried, and what you believe is happening — the questions attack that belief.
example:
/Rubber
Bug: state resets on route change
Belief: the provider remounts
Tried: memoising the provider, logging in useEffect
